queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'RustRover %' AND publisher = 'JetBrains s.r.o.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'RustRover %' AND publisher = 'JetBrains s.r.o.' AND version_compare(version, '263.7307.214') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('rustrover.exe','rustrover64.exe'));
